name: nerfsaksham-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Saksham Arora: frugal, teach-me, vhs and lofi.

plugins.name: frugal
plugins.description: Cost-free mode: helper agents run on Haiku, and big files and logs are summarised by a free Gemini model instead of filling Claude's context.

plugins.name: teach-me
plugins.description: Learn while Claude codes: after a turn that changed code, one question about that exact change appears above the prompt. Scored per concept.

plugins.name: vhs
plugins.description: A tape of every edit Claude makes: replay each change typing itself in, step through it, and rewind any file to any step.

plugins.name: lofi
plugins.description: A lofi soundtrack that follows the session: calm, focus, flow, plus cues for passing and failing tests. Original music.
